Episode 144. For a Friend (8)
The psychological pressure was unbearable for the culprits.
For the imperial army, it was a war without any stakes, any justifications, any hatred.
Those who participated in a fight that was just about choosing a winning and a losing side, like siding with children, could not possibly have an unyielding will or burning determination.
All the common knights and mages in the rear battle had completely lost their fighting spirit. It happened less than thirty minutes after Jin appeared.
Once Jin started walking again, the common knights and mages who had been blocking him - or rather, who had simply been standing a good distance away from him - split apart and avoided him.
It was hell whether they faced him or ran away.
None of the common knights chose the former. Those whose legs were not frozen ran madly out of the battlefield, and those who couldn't, cried and fled in fear.
As promised, Jin did not pursue the fleeing enemies.
However, the enemy leaders could not do so.
"You crazy bastards...! Fight, those who run away will die by my hand!"
"Do you think you can bear the sin of defying the emperor's order? Rather die fighting, it can prevent your family from being killed and your lineage from being destroyed!"
Even with the vicious orders of the imperial army commanders, the common knights did not stop fleeing.
The decision of who was more terrifying, the emperor or Jin Runcandel, had already been made.
The commanders eventually began to cut down the fleeing common knights and mages themselves.
However, even as this spectacle continued, the common knights did not stop leaving the battlefield.

As the situation reached this point, the commanders had no choice but to panic. Even if they were united and bonded, they couldn't stand against the approaching knight of Runcandel. The lines were already scattered to the point of chaos.
All that was left were the main knights and Henserk, the Lilystar Magic Corps.
But all they could do was prepare for death.
Most of the maximum power dragon spears were destroyed or seized, and Jin, who had not tired at all despite bombarding them with final skills, was pressuring them with his intense killing intent.
They couldn't even get support from the front and side battlefields.
The front was still being held by Dante, and the sides were each being swept by the Proch siblings, Kasimir, Alisa, Julian, Kuzan, and Gilly.
Even the imperial forces in the rear were trying to take the evacuees of Sword Emperor Castle, who hadn't been able to leave, as hostages.
It could be the worst own goal later, but they thought it was the only way to shake the battlefield.
However, even that was failing because of Jin's companions.
"Mesa, Scutt! Prioritize protecting the refugees with your squad. Velop, you're with me to catch the enemy leader!"
Rutan Ferma, the former execution knight of Runcandel, and the youngest division.
They, too, were part of this war.
Having been trained hard by Rutan, and being the original guardians of Runcandel, the knights of the imperial rear couldn't stand against them.
And so, Jin and his companions were wreaking havoc on the battlefield, their blood boiling with rage.
"For the lord!"
"For the lord and Hyran!"
"Rescue our allies, gather the wounded!"
With the enemy of the knight level running away, the cheers grew louder than the screams.
Everyone knew that the war wouldn't end in an easy victory.
But the knights of the Imperial Palace were now filled with hope that they could move from despair towards victory.
"The dragon spears are gathering around Amella! Currently eight, and still increasing!"
"She wasn't killed in the Gaipa army, she became a member of the 12th generation...!"
In a large-scale war, Amella's abilities shine particularly brightly. She was continuously gathering dragon spears using her ability and the power of Balkas.

At the same time, she was rapidly modifying them. Dozens of hands created by her ability were busily moving, removing parts from broken dragon spears and other cannons, and attaching them to the stolen dragon spears.
"Artillery fire complete! My lord, preparation is almost done! If you give the order, we will start supporting front-line bombardment!"
Upon Jin's nod, Amella popped out of her bush clothes and saluted.
"Order received! Please look forward to Amella's exciting artillery support!"
Following Amella's hand, the dragon spears all raised their barrels at once.
"Boom!"
Whoa!
Eight dragon spears were fired at the sky at the same time.
The shells were seen going beyond the Imperial Palace, far into the front, all the way to where the emperor was.
Even without any visibility, Amella fired the cannons without hesitation.
She was accurately measuring a safe distance where her allies wouldn't be harmed just by the vibrations of the battlefield.
It was no lie that Balkas evaluated that no one could follow Amella when it came to war.
Dante caught his breath and looked at the cannons falling like meteors far above the emperor's army.
He saw the shells being blocked. Henser and the Lillistar Magic Squad's elites were spreading shields.
However, the dragon spear is the empire's strongest weapon of war.
It wasn't something that the wizards could easily block. Especially when not one, but eight of them were firing at once.
The magic power of the emperor's magic squad was amplified to a level that even knights like him could feel, and ordinary knights could see with their own eyes.
As far as Dante knew, the Empire did not have such a level of technology. The ability to amplify magic power on such a scale was virtually unheard of in academia or history.
Only the Zifl could do it.
Dante didn't hear Alton's warning, but he was sure that the emperor had made some kind of deal with the Zifl.
'All because of that damn white stone...!'
The white stone, that object had been darkening Dante's inner self since before the war started.
And when the cup of war was spilled, the hatred and anger that started from the white stone were growing faster and faster.
Amella's dragon spears were not failing to inflict damage on the emperor's army.
The elite of the magic squad were only protecting key personnel including the emperor, not the lives of ordinary knights.
Dante gripped his sword again.

He was suddenly frightened of himself, who felt no emotion at the death of the emperor's knights and wizards exploding in front of him, and was rather enveloped in a sense of pleasure as if it was a rightful death.
But the war was just beginning.
"Move aside, I will kill the emperor."
The royal guards and ordinary knights scattered in front of Dante's sword.
After a while, a giant man emerged between them.
"... Sir Dante."
Dragon King Knight, Imperial Sword.
John Cena Feral stood in Dante's way. Unlike Dante, who looked like a hideous demon, his blue armor shone even in the darkness.

John Cena's heroic tales and various stories inspired many knights in the world. Although he didn't receive much attention for his personal power being overshadowed by Ron, John Cena was an inspiration for the knights.
Dante had respected him very much.
That's why he sneered.
"I expected you to be with the emperor's army since Kevin Feral came... But seeing you blocking my way directly, I can't stand the disgusting feeling."
Spit, Dante spat out blood.
Instead of answering, John Cena gathered his energy. The ground where he stood vibrated, and small piles of stones scattered and rose.
"Have you been feeling inferior to my grandfather for a long time? Or did you want to see the Feral family become the pillar of the empire instead of Hyran?"
His voice trembled with betrayal.
Even if the entire Dragon King Knights blindly followed the emperor's command, he was sure that John Cena would not forget his honor.
Just as Dante was about to mock him again.
John Cena disappeared from his sight. By the time he hastily turned his gaze, John Cena's greatsword was already falling towards his shoulder.
Crack, snap-!
As soon as he blocked the attack, his shoulder was dislocated. Dante, who was pushed back, rolled on the ground, and John Cena's sword energy poured down on him.
Dante quickly readjusted his shoulder bone, stood up, and swung his sword to fend off the sword energy. His staggering legs seemed to lose balance at any moment.
The sword of the Imperial Sword was too powerful for Dante to easily handle with his broken body.
"Stop it."
"You or that guy, you're all jabbering about stopping after stabbing the sword into the imperial city first. Aren't you ashamed, you hypocrite!"
Dante charged with all his might, but his sword couldn't penetrate John Cena's greatsword.
With each exchange of blows, Dante's bones and organs were damaged, causing him to vomit blood, while John Cena didn't even lose his breath.
He was like an iron wall.
John Cena showed a clear difference in skill from the knights Dante had faced before.
"Please."
"Ha, please?"
"I don't want to see you die."
"You're talking as if you're looking out for me, the commander of the Dragon King Knights... It seems that I appear funny to you now that I'm exhausted and vomiting blood..."
Dante's body turned pale.
It was a sign that another hidden technique of the Emperor's Sword was about to unfold. And John Cena knew what that sword was risking to be unleashed.
It was his life.
"Do you really plan to die with someone like me? When will you stop playing the villain, Dante Hyran! You should rather plan for the future!"
You are the ruler of the imperial city now!
John Cena shouted with his eyes wide open.
"If you die, Hyran will never rise again. Why do you keep throwing yourself into the darkness of an inch ahead, is this the image that Ron wants!"
"How dare you bring my honorable grandfather into your filthy mouth...!"
[Meow-!]
At that moment, Shuri, the Red Jewel Cat, who had run without rest as soon as the rear battle was settled, threw herself between Dante and John Cena.
Jin was riding on Shuri's back.
Dante had been aware of Jin's arrival since the first time the bluish sword energy lit up the night sky, but he hadn't expected Jin to clean up the rear so quickly and come to him.
He also hadn't thought that he should join Jin and rearrange the battle line.
That's how much he was stuck in the quagmire inside.
So many Hyrans and knights following Hyran had died. It was impossible for him to try to survive alone, even a little bit.
"Dante."
Jin spoke as if he knew everything about Dante's inner thoughts.
"I wouldn't have come to help if I only wanted to save you. I came to save both you and the imperial city. So, don't fight now as if this is the end. Don't forget there's a next time."
